class.name: simple_joint_impedance_controller/SimpleJointImpedanceController
class.description: Lightweight joint-space PD impedance controller: tau = K (q_d - q) - D qdot, with per-joint torque and torque-rate saturation and URDF-limit clamping on the target. See docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-0008 for the feature-split rationale.
